summary: Describes IS-IS extensions that support IEEE 802.1aq Shortest Path Bridging, which provides true shortest-path forwarding across equal-cost paths in mesh Ethernet networks. It allows much larger Layer 2 topologies with faster convergence and better use of the mesh.

eli5.summary: Normal Ethernet networks use only part of their cables to avoid loops. This lets switches find the quickest route and use many cables at once, so big networks work faster.
